META4.0 prepares engineers for the Industry 4.0 transition — smart manufacturing, industrial IoT, digital twins and data-driven production — across an Erasmus Mundus consortium of technical universities. Each year's call, including the exact closing date and scholarship places, is published on the programme site.

Programme Highlights

  • Industry 4.0 specialisation: IIoT, digital twins and smart production
  • Mobility across European technical universities with industry projects
  • Call-specific deadlines published annually on the official page
  • Graduates enter manufacturing digitalisation, automation and industrial data roles

Who Should Apply

Engineering graduates in mechanical, electrical, industrial and mechatronics disciplines with programming interest are the core applicants.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students per the live call.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the META4.0 website for the current call, then submit through the consortium's application form with the requested documents. Key deadline information: Current call and closing date published on the official programme page.
